question: Which of the following tissues is very elastic and used to connect two bones in our body?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ligament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Ligaments** are tough, elastic connective tissues that connect one bone to another at joints.
 
• They provide **stability** to joints while allowing a certain degree of movement.
 
• The elasticity of ligaments enables them to absorb shock and maintain the structural integrity of the skeletal system.
 
• Ligaments are primarily composed of **collagen and elastic fibers**, which give them tensile strength and flexibility.
